name: Vinblastine sulfate

name: Tretinoin
cmax_conditions: single dose, mean (SD 266); falls to ~138 ng/mL with continued dosing

name: Paclitaxel
cmax_conditions: 175 mg/m2 over 3 h, label PK table (n=5)
source_cmax: Paclitaxel label PK table (Pfizer / Gland Pharma SPL)
dosing_notes: label gives binding as 89-98%; midpoint used

name: Tamoxifen citrate
cmax_conditions: average steady-state concentration after 3 months (range 71-183); long half-life so peak is close
dosing_notes: active metabolite N-desmethyl tamoxifen at ~353 ng/mL not counted; binding not captured

name: Valrubicin
route: INTRAVESICAL ONLY - not for IV use
cmax_conditions: plasma 0-10 ng/mL after intravesical dosing (intact bladder)
dosing_notes: cannot be given systemically: will never reach a lung tumour

name: Mitoxantrone
cmax_conditions: APPROXIMATE: upper end of the plasma range (26-455 ng/mL) observed in patients per label binding data
dosing_notes: no labelled Cmax at standard dose; treat as approximate

name: Docetaxel
source_dose: Docetaxel label: 75 mg/m2 single agent after platinum failure

name: Estramustine disodium phosphate
cmax_conditions: the tested compound (estramustine phosphate) is NOT detectable in plasma after oral dosing; only metabolites

name: Gefitinib
